mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user (username, password, phone, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET nickname=#{nickname}, avatar=#{avatar}, gender=#{gender}, email=#{email}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id =#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_user ORDER BY create_time DESC
